placements.why: The content describes a mandatory onboarding process and its recent supersession of a prior artifact — organizational governance of operational practice. No existing strata or structure exists to hold this; the content names an organizational category that nothing yet covers.
placements.title: Operational processes as governed artifacts
placements.frame: How are organizational processes established, maintained, and superseded?

placements.title: Onboarding as governed practice
placements.frame: How is the onboarding process established and maintained as a governance artifact?
placements.why: src-1 states the universal rule — every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) in their first week — performing a mandatory operational mandate. src-2 reports the supersession that made it current (replacing the old wiki page last quarter). Together they constitute a theme of onboarding as a governed process that is both mandated and kept current, a subject future envelopes will keep feeding. No existing leaf holds this.
